_note: One entry per credit-spending family named in docs/planning/attack.md F13. measured=false means credits_per_event is NOT a known fact -- src.capture.budget.can_spend refuses to spend against it (PROBE_REQUIRED) until `python3 -m src.cli budget --probe <family>` records a real 1-credit measurement here. Never hand-edit credits_per_event to a guessed number; that is exactly the unmeasured-cost failure F13 names.
